## Graphic

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sportyR)

set.seed(42)

dir.create("year_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

seasons <- 2007:2024

for (yr in seasons) {
  yr_label <- paste0(substr(yr, 3, 4), "/", substr(yr + 1, 3, 4))

  yr_shots <- read_csv(paste0("data/shots_", yr, ".csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      event_label = case_when(
        goal == 1 ~ "Goal",
        event == "MISS" ~ "Miss",
        TRUE ~ "Shot on Goal"
      ),
      event_label = factor(event_label, levels = c("Shot on Goal", "Miss", "Goal")),
      x_jitter = xCord + runif(n(), -0.4, 0.4),
      y_jitter = pmax(-42.5, pmin(42.5, arenaAdjustedYCord + runif(n(), -0.4, 0.4))),
      corner_r = 28,
      corner_cx = 72,
      corner_cy = 14.5,
      dist_br = sqrt((x_jitter - corner_cx)^2 + (y_jitter + corner_cy)^2),
      dist_tr = sqrt((x_jitter - corner_cx)^2 + (y_jitter - corner_cy)^2),
      dist_bl = sqrt((x_jitter + corner_cx)^2 + (y_jitter + corner_cy)^2),
      dist_tl = sqrt((x_jitter + corner_cx)^2 + (y_jitter - corner_cy)^2),
      in_corner_br = x_jitter > corner_cx & y_jitter < -corner_cy,
      in_corner_tr = x_jitter > corner_cx & y_jitter > corner_cy,
      in_corner_bl = x_jitter < -corner_cx & y_jitter < -corner_cy,
      in_corner_tl = x_jitter < -corner_cx & y_jitter > corner_cy,
      x_jitter = if_else(in_corner_br & dist_br > corner_r, corner_cx + corner_r * (x_jitter - corner_cx) / dist_br, x_jitter),
      y_jitter = if_else(in_corner_br & dist_br > corner_r, -corner_cy + corner_r * (y_jitter + corner_cy) / dist_br, y_jitter),
      x_jitter = if_else(in_corner_tr & dist_tr > corner_r, corner_cx + corner_r * (x_jitter - corner_cx) / dist_tr, x_jitter),
      y_jitter = if_else(in_corner_tr & dist_tr > corner_r, corner_cy + corner_r * (y_jitter - corner_cy) / dist_tr, y_jitter),
      x_jitter = if_else(in_corner_bl & dist_bl > corner_r, -corner_cx + corner_r * (x_jitter + corner_cx) / dist_bl, x_jitter),
      y_jitter = if_else(in_corner_bl & dist_bl > corner_r, -corner_cy + corner_r * (y_jitter + corner_cy) / dist_bl, y_jitter),
      x_jitter = if_else(in_corner_tl & dist_tl > corner_r, -corner_cx + corner_r * (x_jitter + corner_cx) / dist_tl, x_jitter),
      y_jitter = if_else(in_corner_tl & dist_tl > corner_r, corner_cy + corner_r * (y_jitter - corner_cy) / dist_tl, y_jitter)
    ) %>%
    select(-corner_r, -corner_cx, -corner_cy, -dist_br, -dist_tr, -dist_bl, -dist_tl,
           -in_corner_br, -in_corner_tr, -in_corner_bl, -in_corner_tl)

  n_goals <- sum(yr_shots$goal == 1)

  rink_colors <- list(
    plot_background = "#161821",
    boards          = "#2e313f",
    ozone_ice       = "#1e2132",
    nzone_ice       = "#1e2132",
    dzone_ice       = "#1e2132",
    center_line     = "#5c3040",
    zone_line       = "#84a0c6",
    goal_line       = "#5c3040",
    restricted_trapezoid = "#5c3040",
    goal_crease_outline = "#5c3040",
    goal_crease_fill = "#2a3a4a",
    referee_crease  = "#3e445e",
    center_faceoff_spot = "#84a0c6",
    faceoff_spot_ring = "#5c3040",
    faceoff_spot_stripe = "#5c3040",
    center_faceoff_circle = "#84a0c6",
    odzone_faceoff_circle = "#5c3040",
    faceoff_line    = "#3a2530",
    goal_frame      = "#5c3040",
    goal_fill       = "#2e313f",
    team_a_bench    = "#2e313f",
    team_b_bench    = "#2e313f",
    team_a_penalty_box = "#2e313f",
    team_b_penalty_box = "#2e313f",
    off_ice_officials_box = "#3e445e"
  )

  p <- geom_hockey("NHL", color_updates = rink_colors) +
    annotate("text", x = -80, y = 0, label = "Away", color = "#c6c8d1", size = 5, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 80, y = 0, label = "Home", color = "#c6c8d1", size = 5, fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(
      data = yr_shots %>% filter(event_label != "Goal"),
      aes(x = x_jitter, y = y_jitter),
      color = "#84a0c6", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = yr_shots %>% filter(event_label == "Goal"),
      aes(x = x_jitter, y = y_jitter),
      color = "#e27878", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Season", yr_label),
      subtitle = paste0(nrow(yr_shots) %>% prettyNum(big.mark = ","), " shots  |  ",
                        n_goals %>% prettyNum(big.mark = ","), " goals"),
      caption = "Data: NHL play-by-play via sportyR | Current as of 2026-06-15 03:40 ET"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "#c6c8d1"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "#818596"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, color = "#6b7089"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#161821", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#161821", color = NA)
    )

  ggsave(paste0("year_plots/plot_", yr, ".png"), p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 150)
}
```

```{=html}
<div style="display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start;">
  <div style="width: 90px; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 40px;">
    <p style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #c6c8d1;">Season</p>
    <div id="season-buttons-left" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="plot-display" style="flex: 1;">
    <img id="plot-img" style="width: 100%; border-radius: 4px;" />
  </div>
  <div style="width: 90px; flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 40px;">
    <p style="font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; color: #c6c8d1;">Season</p>
    <div id="season-buttons-right" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const seasons = [2007,2008,2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024];
  const leftContainer = document.getElementById("season-buttons-left");
  const rightContainer = document.getElementById("season-buttons-right");
  const img = document.getElementById("plot-img");
  const mid = Math.ceil(seasons.length / 2);
  const leftSeasons = seasons.slice(0, mid);
  const rightSeasons = seasons.slice(mid);

  function createButton(yr) {
    const label = (yr + "").slice(2) + "/" + (yr + 1 + "").slice(2);
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.textContent = label;
    btn.dataset.year = yr;
    btn.style.cssText = "padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #3e445e;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;background:#1e2132;color:#c6c8d1;transition:all 0.15s;";
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      document.querySelectorAll("#season-buttons-left button, #season-buttons-right button").forEach(function (b) {
        b.style.background = "#1e2132";
        b.style.borderColor = "#3e445e";
        b.style.fontWeight = "normal";
        b.style.color = "#c6c8d1";
      });
      btn.style.background = "#84a0c6";
      btn.style.borderColor = "#84a0c6";
      btn.style.color = "#161821";
      btn.style.fontWeight = "bold";
      img.src = "year_plots/plot_" + yr + ".png";
    });
    return btn;
  }

  leftSeasons.forEach(function (yr) { leftContainer.appendChild(createButton(yr)); });
  rightSeasons.forEach(function (yr) { rightContainer.appendChild(createButton(yr)); });

  document.querySelector("#season-buttons-left button").click();
});
</script>
```
